shared_elements: band of repeated short parallel strokes
justification: The only genuine correspondence is generic: both surfaces bear shallow, schematic carved motifs, including a band of repeated short parallel strokes and some long curving lines. Otherwise the depicted content differs fundamentally — B is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a head, ears and torso bearing specific relief motifs (concentric ring/disc, paired arcs, girdle-like bands), while A shows only an isolated elongated comb- or vessel-like linear motif with no figure, no disc and no bodily framework.
